The league‑phase draw is conducted (often digitally) after the 36 clubs have been placed into four pots of nine clubs each, based on their club‑coefficient rankings with the Champions League title‑holder seeded at the top of pot 1[1].  

During the draw each club is paired with **two opponents from each of the other three pots**, so that it faces a total of eight different teams – one match at home and one away against each pot‑opponent[1][2].  

The draw is subject to association rules: clubs from the same national association cannot be drawn together, and a club may face at most two opponents from any other single association (subject to further detailed limits)[2].  

If necessary, UEFA may modify the draw conditions to avoid deadlocks or to meet other constraints set by the UEFA Club Competitions Committee[2].
